*Kusalattika, Micchattaniyatattika* (Patthana 17.14) is an Abhidhamma text in the canonical Pali *Paṭṭhāna* [SuttaCentral]. The text analyzes the conditional relations arising from the intersection of the wholesome triad (*kusalattika*) and the triad of fixed destiny (*micchattaniyatattika*) [SuttaCentral]. No specific discussions or translations of this text were identified in the queried secondary literature.
According to DharmaNexus, the text exhibits extensive internal textual reuse across the Pali canon, sharing 93 matching passages with 34 other texts, which are situated throughout other sections of the *Paṭṭhāna* [DharmaNexus]. The most substantial textual reuse is found in *Kusalattika, Piṭṭhiduka* (Patthana 16.25; segments §1.1–3.1 aligning with §31.1–33.1) and *Hetuduka, Mahantaraduka* (Patthana 24.6; segments §1.1–2.1 aligning with §10.1–11.1) [DharmaNexus]. Other notable alignments occur with *Kusalattika, Dassanattika* (Patthana 17.7), *Hetuduka, Dassanenapahātabbadukādi* (Patthana 18.8), *Hetuduka, Āsavagocchaka* (Patthana 24.4), and another treatment under the same pair heading, *Kusalattika, Micchattaniyatattika* (Patthana 23.14; §0.2–3.1) [DharmaNexus]. Neither curated parallels on SuttaCentral nor significant cross-language alignments in non-Pali corpora are recorded [SuttaCentral; DharmaNexus].
